Parent epic: bd-01M57PRFCXCDXPB434WTVM24ZJ

Plan SHA256: 0224854b40537bb5866a73a563e72428473e1ded2cfbd1f0a98b4ffc0b20979b

Classification: audit qualification follow-up, separate from the thirteen confirmed defects. Preserve the parent scientific-scope limits.

Action and paths
Design-MFA inference/tuning docs and tests. State the frozen reference grid, conditional target, resampling unit, caller-owned null action, and the tuning score's effect-recovery interpretation. Keep the supplied-null callback requirement.

Acceptance evidence / regression tests
Invalid/mismatched callback outputs are rejected; subject-resampling and fold-local reference grids have direct identity tests. Calibrating a claimed rejection rate needs a separate protocol with a specified generator/null, replicate count, raw outcomes, binomial uncertainty, and locked code hashes. A callback contract test alone does not establish exchangeability.

Completion: record the tested source revision, precise regression names, retained receipts, and unresolved scientific assumptions. A smoke test does not establish calibration.
set.title: Q03: Conditional target and exchangeability
